label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Not counted: our browser engine could not press a visible control (its click waited and timed out), a fault on our side, not the shop's. The customer will shop here again.

reclassified.why: our browser engine could not press a visible control (its click waited and timed out), a fault on our side, not the shop's. The customer will shop here again.

findings.problem: The privacy dialog offers only Cookies Settings and Accept All Cookies, with no Reject or Decline button, so a customer who wants to refuse non-essential cookies has no direct way to do so.

In the preference center the three optional cookie switches are announced as checked but clicking or checking them timed out, so I could not switch them off. The only other buttons were Allow All and Confirm My Choices, which would keep everything on.

After closing the preference center the Privacy dialog stayed open and a dark overlay covered the whole page. Escape did not close it and every page link was blocked, so the shop could not be used without accepting cookies.

The home page tree showed no main navigation, search box, product links or cart link. Only two Shop Now links with no hint of what they lead to, and several links named only Content, so finding a product would be hard even without the overlay.

The announcement bar text and link name change on their own: the link keeps the name Complimentary Jewelry Cleaning at Stores while its text says other things such as Free Shipping On All Orders, which is confusing.
